title: Hearty Algerian Ackee Hash
description: A flavorful and filling breakfast dish that combines the tender ackee fruit with the savory flavors of Algerian cuisine. Serve with crusty bread or over eggs for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: Ackee Fruit
ingredients.notes: Canned ackee is a convenient alternative to fresh.

ingredients.name: Hash Browns
ingredients.notes: Leftover hash browns work well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Sauté the onion until softened before adding the ackee.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and sauté with the onion.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Add a Middle Eastern twist with ground cumin.

ingredients.name: Cayenne Pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a touch of heat with cayenne pepper.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of black pepper for flavor.

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced hash browns and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the canned ackee fruit, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the ackee is heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
